blocks.inputs: Validated account/content input and exact current stored state.
blocks.invariants: Unique normalized email, current session generation, published-parent media and no partial disk/memory mutation.
blocks.outputs: Committed state or explicit rejection, with no secret material in public output.
blocks.pseudocode: Load authoritative state; validate roles and inputs; clone under mutex; apply bounded mutation; persist complete bytes; publish memory only on success.
blocks.scale_or_limits: Single process, bounded bodies/media, bounded concurrent derivations; no production scale claim.

mappings.null_or_default: New account enabled as fan unless explicit empty-store bootstrap
mappings.transformation: Validate email/password limits, salt and derive with vendored PBKDF2; expose only public projection
mappings.validation: Unique email, declared lengths, protected role assignment

mappings.null_or_default: New content draft unless explicitly published
mappings.target: Bounded track/album/photo records and controlled bytes
mappings.transformation: Validate MIME/size/dimensions, persist complete association and recheck publication on reads
mappings.validation: Reject missing parent, bad content and unauthorized changes

blocks.classification: Visible bounded failure, never silently completed work.
blocks.handling: Reject before invalid mutation; preserve successful committed state and exact failure evidence.
blocks.observable_result: Denied HTTP or nonpassing runtime check; no fabricated authority.
blocks.recovery: Correct bounded source or execution environment, then retry under the same valid scope or formal rework.
blocks.trigger: Invalid input, unauthorized operation, stale source, failed storage, compilation or test.

blocks.consistency_or_atomicity: Store clone/validate/persist/rename precedes memory publication; runtime checkpoints each declared source effect.
blocks.failure_handling: Keep failure evidence; no remote service, production write or history replacement.
blocks.idempotency: Confirmation and retry never replay completed source operations.
blocks.order_and_condition: Core source first, dependent web handlers next, then actual tests; writes bind exact existing content.
blocks.resource_or_effect: Current source snapshot and in-application local state effects only.
